latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs have erased a $5.8 billion hole

latest.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
latest.description: KelpDAO says LayerZero endorsed its bridge setup before the attack, while CEO Bryan Pellegrino has dismissed the lawsuit as meritless.
